{"metadata":{"description":"Connect your sub2api gateway to DeepSeek Harness: OpenAI-compatible multi-provider routes (OpenAI / Claude / Grok / Gemini) behind one base URL, with per-key model discovery, usage lookup, and a settings page.","id":"gh:1334700321","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-sub2api","slug":"GodD6366/dsh-sub2api","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Connect your sub2api gateway to DeepSeek Harness: OpenAI-compatible multi-provider routes (OpenAI / "},{"id":"p1s2","text":"Claude / Grok / Gemini) behind one base URL, with per-key model discovery, usage lookup, and a setti"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"Grok / Gemini) behind one base URL, with per-key model discovery, usage lookup, and a settings page."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-sub2api"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"中文文档"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Connect your sub2api gateway to DeepSeek Harness as model providers."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Sub2API is an AI API gateway that turns subscription quota into OpenAI-compatible endpoints. In its "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"model, **each API key is bound to a group, and the group decides the platform** (OpenAI / Claude / G"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"rok) and the models that key can serve. The three provider routes (`sub2api-openai`, `sub2api-claude"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"`, `sub2api-grok`) are served by the harness's own pi-ai adapter (`dsh-llm-pi-ai`): this plugin tran"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"slates its `llm-sub2api:` settings into `llm-pi-ai:` provider profiles (all sharing one **bare-host*"},{"id":"p5s6","text":"* base URL, no `/v1`), and protocol serialization, streaming, and usage accounting all live in pi-ai"},{"id":"p5s7","text":". The same gateway serves OpenAI, Claude, and Grok models side by side, and the harness routes each "},{"id":"p5s8","text":"request to the key whose group owns the requested model."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Image generation**: select a generation model in settings. `generate_image` saves images to the "},{"id":"p7s2","text":"workspace and returns an inline attachment. The separate image-analysis tool and its model selector "},{"id":"p7s3","text":"rns an inline attachment. The separate image-analysis tool and its model selector have been removed."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **One base URL, three provider routes**: `sub2api-openai`, `sub2api-claude`, `sub2api-grok` — each"},{"id":"p8s2","text":" configured with its own key and at least one model, registered as a live LLM provider as soon as bo"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"th are set.
- **Streaming chat (backed by pi-ai)**: SSE streaming, tool calls, reasoning deltas, and"},{"id":"p8s4","text":" token usage are mapped to the harness protocol by `dsh-llm-pi-ai`, which natively handles wire-form"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"at details like top-level `function_call` items in the Responses API.
- **Model discovery**: one-cli"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"ck "fetch models" calls `GET {baseURL}/v1/models` with the key, so each route's catalog matches exac"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"tly what the sub2api group serves.
- **Reasoning effort (thinking mode)**: `reasoning_effort` is pas"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"sed straight through to the gateway and adjustable right in the chat model selector; the settings pa"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"ge's per-model "reasoning strength" field fills each model's real levels from models.dev `reasoning_"},{"id":"p8s10","text":"options` (e.g. `gpt-5.6-sol` → none/low/medium/high/xhigh/max, `deepseek-v4-flash` → low/high/max), "},{"id":"p8s11","text":"editable in the settings page; `reasoningEfforts: []` opts a model out.
- **Usage lookup**: "view us"},{"id":"p8s12","text":"age" calls `GET {baseURL}/v1/usage` and summarizes quota, balance, rate limits, and subscription win"},{"id":"p8s13","text":"dows.
- **Standards-based config**: base URL and model catalogs live in the `llm-sub2api:` settings "},{"id":"p8s14","text":"section (`$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml`, written by the web Models page); keys go through the harness cre"},{"id":"p8s15","text":"dential store.
- **Provider icons** from lobehub/lobe-icons, embedded as SVG in the settings page."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Requires DeepSeek Harness **0.1.2-rc.1 or later**; typecheck, build, and compatibility tests also pa"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"ss against **0.1.3-alpha.2**. This version uses the settings service’s `installSection` API and the "},{"id":"p10s3","text":"`dsh-client-ui-renderer` browser service; `dsh-client-runtime` is no longer required."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"or, from this repository:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Configure"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Open **Settings → Sub2API 模型** (or edit `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml` directly):"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Store each key through the credentials service (the web Models page writes it, or export `SUB2API_OP"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"ENAI_API_KEY=…` etc.). A route activates only when its platform has a key and at least one model; cl"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"ear the key (or empty the model list) to drop the route again."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### Wire protocol (automatic per group)"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"The gateway serves each platform group upstream through its NATIVE protocol, and pi-ai picks the end"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"point automatically from the key's group — no configuration needed. Configure the **bare host** (no "},{"id":"p19s3","text":"`/v1`): OpenAI-style endpoints get `/v1` appended automatically, and the Anthropic SDK appends `/v1/"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"yle endpoints get `/v1` appended automatically, and the Anthropic SDK appends `/v1/messages` itself:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| Group | Protocol used | Endpoint |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| openai | `openai-responses` | `POST {baseURL}/v1/responses` |
| claude | `anthropic-messages` | `P"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"OST {baseURL}/v1/messages` |
| grok | `openai-completions` | `POST {baseURL}/v1/chat/completions` |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Speaking the native protocol means the gateway never has to convert chat/completions — that conversi"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"on is what drops/misaligns tool-call names and ids for parallel calls (`unknown tool ""`, `missing r"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"equired property …`). To force a different endpoint for a group whose gateway does not serve it nati"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"vely, declare `api` on the provider in `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml` (advanced; no settings-page control"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"ly, declare `api` on the provider in `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml` (advanced; no settings-page control):"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"`api` accepts `openai-completions` (`/v1/chat/completions`), `openai-responses` (`/v1/responses`), o"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"r `anthropic-messages` (`/v1/messages`); omitted means the automatic group default above."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"### Relationship to dsh-llm-pi-ai"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"This plugin no longer implements the LLM protocol layer itself: the three `sub2api-*` routes are ser"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"ved by `dsh-llm-pi-ai` (shipped dormant with dsh-base) through `llm-pi-ai:` settings profiles. On ev"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"ery `llm-sub2api:` change (and at boot) the plugin translates the bare-host base URL, per-group mode"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"ls, and key references into hand-declared profiles and writes them to `llm-pi-ai:`, so routes regist"},{"id":"p26s5","text":"er/drop live. The settings page, model discovery (`GET /v1/models`), usage lookup (`GET /v1/usage`),"},{"id":"p26s6","text":" the image-generation tool remain this plugin's own."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"> **Dependency note (pi-ai multi-turn guard)**: pi-ai's `AssistantMessage.usage` is required in its "},{"id":"p27s2","text":"types and its prefix-token estimation dereferences it. The harness path is already safe: `dsh-llm-pi"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"-ai` attaches a zero `Usage` to every reconstructed assistant message. This plugin still applies a d"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"efensive guard at boot (`assistant.usage !== undefined` before counting prefix tokens) to `@earendil"},{"id":"p27s5","text":"-works/pi-ai/dist/utils/estimate.js` inside the dsh install, protecting other callers that build pi-"},{"id":"p27s6","text":"ai contexts without `usage`. The patch is idempotent and is re-applied automatically after a dsh upg"},{"id":"p27s7","text":"rade; on a read-only install run `node scripts/patch-pi-ai.mjs` manually.
>"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"### Image input & reasoning effort"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":true}
